description: This source file implements parsing and validation functions for Certificate Transparency (CT) log responses, including JSON decoding of Signed Tree Heads and consistency proofs.

classes.name: JsonSignedTreeHead
classes.description: Struct for JSON decoding of Signed Tree Head with registration for JSON conversion.

classes.name: JsonConsistencyProof
classes.description: Struct for JSON decoding of consistency proof nodes with registration for JSON conversion.

methods.name: RegisterJSONConverter
methods.description: Registers JSON fields for JsonSignedTreeHead or JsonConsistencyProof.

methods.name: IsJsonSTHStructurallyValid
methods.description: Validates the structure of a Signed Tree Head JSON object.

methods.name: ConvertIndividualProofNode
methods.description: Converts a base64-encoded proof node to string.

methods.name: FillSignedTreeHead
methods.description: Fills a SignedTreeHead object from JSON data.

methods.name: FillConsistencyProof
methods.description: Fills a vector of strings with proof nodes from JSON data.
